name: Basic Text Mining (tokenization, stopwords, wordcloud, n-grams, word correlation)
when_to_use: Text corpus (e.g., Project Gutenberg books); preliminary steps before any text modeling — tokenization, removal of stopwords/accents, stemming, bigrams, correlation between words.
notes: Depends on internet access for gutenberg_download().

expected_input.question: What are the preliminary steps for analyzing a text corpus?

plain_explanation.purpose: Prepares and counts words in texts to discover what is being talked about.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: As the first step of any text analysis.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A column with free text, one document per row.
plain_explanation.example: Discover the most cited terms in expense descriptions.
plain_explanation.diagram: text -> split words -> remove empty words -> count
